name: Greptile
tagline: AI code reviewer that indexes the whole codebase into a graph; its TREX agent writes and runs tests for PRs in a sandbox.
pricing: Free 50 credits/mo (1 dev); Pro $30/seat/mo with 50 credits/seat, $1 per extra credit; TREX review = 3 credits; Enterprise custom; OSS and startup programs
selfHostedNote: Self-hosted deployment on custom-priced Enterprise tier, alongside SOC 2 Type II and SSO/SAML.
modelControl: Fixed vendor models; no BYOK on standard plans

01-multi-dimensional-context.note: Graph index of the full codebase gives deep cross-file context; ticket/business context is not a focus.

02-rule-centric.note: Plain-English custom rules on Pro; community reports on default precision/noise are mixed.

03-dual-workflow.note: PR-focused; MCP, Claude Code plugin, and one-click IDE fixes exist, but no local review surface documented.

04-business-logic.note: Focus is code-side context rather than ticket-side; no requirements validation documented.

05-continuous-learning.note: Learns team standards by reading your PR comments over time.

06-sandbox-validation.note: TREX writes and runs tests for each PR in a sandbox to demonstrate bugs (3 credits per review).

07-economic-transparency.note: No BYOK or model choice on standard plans; credit billing does not expose model costs.

08-actionability.note: One-click IDE fixes and /greploop iterative resolution with coding agents.

09-measurable-roi.note: No review-metrics or ROI dashboards documented in the sources we verified.
